title: dsh-cockpit board, format version 1
description: One board file: $DSH_HOME/data/dsh-cockpit/boards/<encodeURIComponent(key)>.json. This schema is also the format of a local file that a hub without the plugin writes (decision 14), at a path its own setup names, read the same way (the reader takes a file path); it is never the plugin's own store, whose files only the plugin writes. Write such a file to a temporary file, then rename it over the board file. Fields this schema does not name are allowed and kept.

key.description: The board's key, named by the hub (decision 11).

parent.description: Free-form reference to the parent ticket.

revision.description: Counts changes to tasks or to parent. A drift check that changes no task does not bump it.

updatedBy.description: The writing session's id, or any identifier a fallback hub uses.

status.description: done and dropped are closed: a closed task blocks nothing. dropped is work that will not be done.

item.description: Identity on the board, unique on it (decision 15).

nextAction.description: What happens next, and who acts.

waitingOn.description: Who or what a waiting task waits on. 'owner', in any case, puts the task in Needs you.

readyCommand.description: The command the owner runs. Stored and shown, never run.

startWhen.description: The condition for starting, shown as 'Start when'.

parent.description: The item of another task on this board.

dependsOn.description: Items on this board that come first.

updatedAt.description: Set by the plugin on every change.

drift.description: The last drift check. items holds only the entries whose status differs from their task's; checked counts every entry the command reported. A failed check has error instead.
